name: Finance
description: Manages financial health, ensures fiscal responsibility, and provides strategic financial guidance

roles.name: Financial Manager
roles.description: Manages financial operations and provides strategic financial guidance to support business growth
responsibilities: Maintain accurate financial records and reporting
Manage cash flow, budgeting, and financial forecasting
Ensure compliance with accounting standards and regulations
Provide financial insights for strategic decision-making

roles.name: Financial Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes financial data to provide insights and support business decisions
responsibilities: Conduct financial analysis and risk assessment
Support investment decisions and capital allocation

roles.name: Financial Controller
roles.description: Ensures financial accuracy, compliance, and internal controls across the organization
responsibilities: Ensure internal controls and financial security
Coordinate with external auditors and regulatory bodies
Manage vendor relationships and payment processing
Maintain compliance with financial regulations and standards

plan.prompt: Develop comprehensive financial planning and budgeting strategy based on business objectives.
Analyze financial data and create forecasting models to support the financial strategy.
Ensure compliance and internal controls are in place for the financial strategy.
Finalize the financial strategy with risk assessment and performance monitoring framework.
